ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $O$ is a point inside $\triangle ABC$ such that the distances from point $O$ to the three sides of $\triangle ABC$ are equal. Given that $\angle BOC = 134^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle A$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since the point O is equidistant from the sides of $\triangle ABC$,\\
it follows that BO bisects $\angle ABC$ and CO bisects $\angle ACB$,\\
therefore $\angle A = 180^\circ - (\angle ABC + \angle ACB) = 180^\circ - 2(\angle OBC + \angle OCB) = 180^\circ - 2 \times (180^\circ - \angle BOC) = 180^\circ - 2 \times (180^\circ - 134^\circ) = \boxed{88^\circ}$
